tools.name: design_get
tools.description: Flush the bound editor and return the complete canonical project-v2 document, revision, and hash.

tools.name: design_validate
tools.description: Flush the bound editor and validate the complete visible design against live catalogs.

tools.name: catalog_list
tools.description: List live slot, noise, protocol, States Zoo, function, annotation, and generator catalogs.

tools.name: catalog_get
tools.description: Get documentation, placement, defaults, and parameters for one live catalog entry.

tools.name: design_edit
tools.description: Apply one or more GUI design operations atomically at the expected collaboration revision.

tools.name: simulation_prepare
tools.description: Flush, validate, parse, and prepare through the bound browser simulation controller.

tools.name: simulation_run
tools.description: Run one additional duration through the browser controller; poll simulation_status for progress.

tools.name: simulation_pause
tools.description: Pause through the bound browser simulation controller.

tools.name: simulation_resume
tools.description: Resume toward the existing cumulative target through the browser controller.

tools.name: simulation_reset
tools.description: Destroy/reset the bound simulation and restore design editability without changing the design.

tools.name: simulation_status
tools.description: Return lifecycle phase, progress, target, and serialized bound simulation state.

tools.name: simulation_results
tools.description: Return the serialized bound simulation result summary.

tools.name: simulation_slot_result
tools.description: Return one bound simulation slot result and representation resource links.

tools.name: simulation_protocol_result
tools.description: Return one bound simulation protocol result and representation resource links.

tools.name: simulation_logs
tools.description: Return non-purging logs from the bound simulator.
